title: Inbox Sentinel — Full Architectural Analysis
summary: Comprehensive analysis of the Inbox Sentinel AI email intelligence platform. Covers the 6-stage AI pipeline (Collector → Normalizer → Prefilter → Analyzer → Decision → Notifier), database schema (16 Prisma models, 12 enums), security architecture (AES encryption via Prisma extensions, Argon2, CSP, audit logging), integration patterns (Gmail OAuth + Pub/Sub, WhatsApp dual-engine Baileys/Meta, Telegram Bot API), interface-driven design (IAIProvider, IEmailProvider, INotificationProvider), and background jobs. Identifies critical bugs: Decision Engine field mismatch (score vs urgencyScore), double encryption in GmailAdapter.persistTokens(), PENDING status not in EmailStatus enum, OpenAI adapter interface incompatibility. Tech stack: Next.js 15, React 19, TypeScript 5, Tailwind v4, Prisma 5, PostgreSQL, Gemini AI with 7-model fallback chain, NextAuth v5.
